title: bidirectional opt-out sentence overstates guarantee
description: Location: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md, ReadPosition section, line 763. Text: 'An account that does not broadcast its own read times does not observe others read times.' Issue: This reads as a bilateral protocol guarantee. In reality the local server only suppresses inbound Peer/receipt readAt delivery when the local account has receiptSharing false; it cannot prevent a remote peer server from sending Peer/receipt calls or retaining readAt on their side. An implementor could misread this as a wire-level symmetry guarantee rather than a local-server-side suppression rule. Suggested rephrasing: 'When receiptSharing is false, the server suppresses inbound readAt delivery to the owner clients (defined in JMAP-CHAT-FED). Remote peers are not prevented from recording or retaining readAt values on their own servers; the suppression is local only.'
close_reason: Resolved: 'in the affected scope' qualifier added; SEC4 R2 confirmed resolved
